title: BibleParallelDisplayContract
description: Formal wire protocol, delimiters, and parsed data structures for Scripture dual-column parallel display across Live, Stage, and remote surfaces

ParallelSlideContent.description: Parsed dual-column parallel slide content produced by parseParallelSlide()

isParallel.description: True if the slide contains dual-column scripture delimited by |||

leftText.description: Raw text content for the left column (including optional [HEADER])

rightText.description: Raw text content for the right column (including optional [HEADER])

primaryText.description: Body text of the primary Bible translation without header tag

secondaryText.description: Body text of the secondary Bible translation without header tag

primaryHeader.description: Optional version tag or label extracted from [HEADER] on primary column

secondaryHeader.description: Optional version tag or label extracted from [HEADER] on secondary column

CanonicalWireSlide.description: Canonical slide format when transmitting dual-translation scripture over the wire

text.description: Text payload containing the canonical ||| column delimiter

PARALLEL_COLUMN_DELIMITER.description: Canonical delimiter separating primary and secondary columns on parallel scripture slides

MAX_VERSES_PER_DUAL_SLIDE.description: Legibility density threshold: at most 2 verses per slide for dual-translation parallel slides

BACKWARD_COMPATIBLE_FALLBACK.description: Clients without dual-column flex layout render full text without crashing or dropping content
